makeborneCorrections: Do not claim that nobody else combines website and presentation generation.
Do not describe Bolt analytics or slides as merely planned.
Makeborne GitHub snapshot export is not repository import or two-way sync.
The real live website builder has AI Plan mode, but the generic home attachment/outline flow is not equivalent.
Tier seat, storage and parallel-work promises need actual enforcement or copy removal.
Custom-domain ownership is not the same as a verified customer-domain connection flow.
Unlimited published sites require disclosure of actual fair-use and safety limits.
Do not promise zero charges for every failed or unchanged request; use durable recorded outcome and charging policy.
priority: Single user-authorized cumulative operation budget with durable recovery
Review version integrity and server-side private-note redaction
Preview, export and hosting fidelity with trusted source identity
Real website, ebook and editable presentation quality qualification
Qualified billing lifecycle, uploads, auth and hosting on the exact staging candidate
Customer custom domains, analytics and consistent attachment consumption
Repository import and two-way code sync, generated application backend services
release: Not launch-ready. Comparative superiority is not established by feature lists or passing unit tests.
